notes: A1257 model match confirmed: official product Amazon link goes to B0CQX67KTW. White ASIN DB title same model; current lot identity not confirmed. Official product page says sold through2025-06-26 recalled; support asks serial verification. Candidate exclusion is conservative editorial decision, not assertion every present retail unit recalled.

Other candidate titles have no model-name match to cited recall lists; this is not a safety certification or current-ASIN identity confirmation. Selected products must still be checked against fresh Amazon features and exact official SKU.
CIO SMARTCOBY SLIM5K without Cable is not Ex01 SLIM Qi2 & Cable. Other SMARTCOBY models are not blanket-recalled by Ex01 notice.
Anker20000mAh87W cable (A1383) differs from recalled20000mAh22.5W cable(A1647); official June support identifies87W product as replacement.
Normal recycle/trade-in programs are not recall notices.

Additional global recall-model match: B0DRFQNPDQ=Japan official A1689012, released2025-09. Official Japan Amazon link confirms ASIN. Global recall lists baseA1689. Exclusion is based on model match, not claim all Japanese/current lots affected. 10000mAh30W Zolo B0DRFR2YT3 differs and is not included by name similarity.
